`ClimPoker` reads the desk in the same transaction as it pokes (`_poke` calls `policy.quoteDirectional()`), so a poke never applies a report from another branch; a reorganized report or poke disappears with its block, the hook keeps what the canonical chain wrote, and the next report and poke rewrite it
